package ar.edu.utn.frc.tup.piv.evaluacionllm;

/** Fixture: complejidad ciclomatica alta. PMD tiene que marcarlo. */
public class MetodoComplejo {

    public String classify(int a, int b, int c, int d) {
        if (a > 0) {
            if (b > 0) {
                if (c > 0) {
                    if (d > 0) {
                        return "all positive";
                    }
                    return "d not positive";
                }
                if (d > 0) {
                    return "c not positive";
                }
                return "c and d not positive";
            }
            if (c > 0) {
                return "b not positive";
            }
            if (d > 0) {
                return "b and c not positive";
            }
            return "only a positive";
        }
        if (b > 0) {
            if (c > 0) {
                return "a not positive";
            }
            return "a and c not positive";
        }
        if (c > 0) {
            return "a and b not positive";
        }
        if (d > 0) {
            return "only d positive";
        }
        return "none positive";
    }
}
